# thermoforming
# Baseline of buildCommodityRules — DO NOT hand-edit.
# Regenerate: npx tsx scripts/snapshot-commodity-rules.ts

### context: full
THERMOFORMING COST INPUT RULES:
  Lines marked deterministic are computed from the measured geometry and will REPLACE whatever you return for them — restate them, do not re-derive them.
  Lines marked UNDECIDED are yours to answer: nothing in the geometry settles them. Answer from the drawing, the photo or the part name, and say which you used.
  materialId: UNDECIDED — needs "Which resin is this moulded in?" (ABS Thermoforming Sheet | HDPE Thermoforming Sheet | PP Thermoforming Sheet (HMS) | PP/TPO Automotive Sheet | HIPS Thermoforming Sheet | Rigid PVC Thermoforming Sheet | PC Thermoforming Sheet)
  method: UNDECIDED — needs "Which resin is this moulded in?" (ABS Thermoforming Sheet | HDPE Thermoforming Sheet | PP Thermoforming Sheet (HMS) | PP/TPO Automotive Sheet | HIPS Thermoforming Sheet | Rigid PVC Thermoforming Sheet | PC Thermoforming Sheet)
